items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was sitting with my wife and my daughter and both of them was pregnant

ctx.x: Oh, Milt, you forgot something. Milt, you know I was sitting in the Embers nightclub and I was sitting with my wife and my daughter and both of them was pregnant and do you know, I became a father and a grandfather at the same time!
Beautiful! That's your daughter Joanne and your wife Lorraine.
